description: Trigger deployment of React web portals (admin, physio, clinic) to staging via GitHub Actions CI/CD. The React app at /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-web has a deploy.yml workflow that handles build, S3 sync, and CloudFront invalidation. DO NOT manually deploy - use the workflow.
steps: Check git status and ensure working tree is clean or commit any pending changes
Push to main branch to ensure latest code is in remote: `git push origin main`
Trigger the deploy.yml workflow via GitHub CLI: `gh workflow run deploy.yml -f environment=staging -f portal=all`
Monitor workflow run: `gh run list --workflow=deploy.yml --limit 1` and `gh run watch`
acceptance_criteria: GitHub Actions workflow deploy.yml triggers successfully
All three portals (admin, physio, clinic) are deployed
verification: Run `gh run list --workflow=deploy.yml --limit 1` to see workflow status
Run `gh run view <run-id>` to verify successful completion
findings: Deployed successfully via workflow run ID 37454372114. Also aligned repo with git-workflow-setup.md: set default branch to main, added Release Please (config + workflow), updated deploy.yml to auto-deploy staging on push to main with production confirmation guard. CI fix: replaced setup-node cache:pnpm with manual pnpm store caching to resolve 'packages field missing or empty' error. Removed invalid pnpm-workspace.yaml that was causing install failures.
